methods.brief: Export images using one or more preset suits.
methods.example:
from evoto.export_options import ExportOptions, FileFormat

matches = evoto.preset.find_by_name("Soft Light")
suit_id = next(
    item["id"] for item in matches
    if item["className"] == "Portrait"
)

opts = (ExportOptions()
    .file_format(FileFormat.JPEG)
    .quality(90)
    .build())

result = evoto.export.start_with_custom(
    project_id=12345,
    export_dir="/output",
    preset_suit_ids=[suit_id],
    imageIds=[101, 202],
    options=opts,
)
print("Export accepted:", result)
